title: A Typewriter for the Clock
author: Freya Sterling
blurb: Felix Eriksen, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, has spent twenty years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must choose which family member gets the last berth before the ice breaks on the river.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
